name: Anekan ~Onee-chan Kansatsu Nikki~
original_name: あねかん ～おねえちゃん観察日記～
source:
Kazuha happens to keep a diary about insects because of science class at school. But he hates insects so choose his older sister as the subject of his observation. Is he able to complete his diary?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE027952.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为了学校的理科课，濑尾和也得写一篇昆虫观察日记。可他偏偏讨厌昆虫，于是决定改以姐姐为观察对象。他能顺利完成这本观察日记吗？
